channel.title: Tool Use Cases: Daily builder log
channel.description: Daily log test, Nov 2–13, 2026. Weekdays only. Only verified breaking changes, deadlines and price changes. Published by Lali Publications.

item.title: Daily builder log: Nov 2, 2026
item.description: Deadline: Jules: Nine days left to keep working in Jules: sessions can continue until Nov 11, 2026, then Jules turns read-only until it shuts down on Dec 31, 2026. Test for this: Install Jules Tools (npm install -g @google/jules), run jules login, and export your settings, memories and sessions now; move open tasks to another coding agent before Nov 11. Source: https://jules.google/docs/changelog/ (checked 10:01 AM PT) | Price change: Bolt.new: Since Nov 1, 2026, Link (by Stripe) bills Bolt plan and domain subscriptions. Plans and token allowances are unchanged, but Link adds sales tax or VAT where your region requires it. Test for this: Check your next Bolt invoice for added tax. If you pay in a local currency instead of USD, expect the charge to move with the exchange rate. Source: https://support.bolt.new/release-notes (checked 10:01 AM PT) | Breaking change: Bolt.new: Starting Oct 30, 2026, new Bolt database tables are private by default, so your app needs explicit permissions to read or write them. Existing databases are not affected. Test for this: Create a new table in a test project and read and write it from the app. If you get a database permissions error, ask Bolt to fix the table permissions. Source: https://support.bolt.new/release-notes (checked 10:01 AM PT) | Deadline: Claude Code: Fast mode for Claude Opus 4.8 was deprecated on Oct 30, 2026 and will be removed on Nov 30, 2026. After that, fast mode requests on Opus 4.8 return an error instead of falling back. Test for this: Search your scripts, settings and API calls for fast mode on Opus 4.8 (speed: "fast" with claude-opus-4-8) and switch them to Opus 5.5 before Nov 30. Source: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md (checked 10:01 AM PT)

item.title: Daily builder log: Oct 31, 2026 (format preview)
item.description: Deadline: Jules: Google is winding Jules down: you can keep working in sessions until Nov 11, 2026, then Jules is read-only until it shuts down on Dec 31, 2026. Test for this: Before Nov 11, export any sessions you need with the Jules Tools CLI (npm install -g @google/jules) and move open tasks to another coding agent. Source: https://jules.google/docs/changelog/ (checked 08:06 PM PT) | Breaking change: Bolt.new: Starting Oct 30, 2026, new Bolt database tables are private by default, so your app needs explicit permissions to read or write them; existing databases are not affected. Test for this: Create a new table in a test project and read and write it from the app; if you get a database permissions error, ask Bolt to fix the table permissions. Source: https://support.bolt.new/release-notes (checked 08:06 PM PT) | Price change: Bolt.new: From Nov 1, 2026, Link (by Stripe) bills Bolt plan and domain subscriptions: plans and token allowances stay the same, but Link adds sales tax or VAT where your region requires it. Test for this: Check your next Bolt invoice for tax; if checkout offers your local currency, note the charge can vary month to month with the exchange rate, and USD stays available for a fixed price. Source: https://support.bolt.new/release-notes (checked 08:09 PM PT) | Deadline: Lovable: Lovable's docs say the current chat pricing (per-message price and daily chat allowance) is a temporary offering that applies through Oct 31, 2026; the page does not say what applies after. Test for this: Recheck the Lovable chat docs and your plan's chat allowance on Nov 2 before budgeting chat-heavy work. Source: https://docs.lovable.dev/features/chats (checked 08:07 PM PT) | Deadline: Claude Code: Fast mode for Opus 4.8 is deprecated as of Oct 30, 2026 and will be removed on Nov 30, 2026; after that, fast mode requests on Opus 4.8 return an error instead of falling back. Test for this: Find scripts and settings that use fast mode with Opus 4.8 and switch them to Opus 5.5 to keep the speedup before Nov 30. Source: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md (checked 08:07 PM PT)
